outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Manchester United FC 1.41 vs Aston Villa FC 1.33, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: Manchester United FC at home: 1W-1D-2L, 6 scored and 7 conceded in 4 games.
Aston Villa FC away: 2W-1D-1L, 4 scored and 6 conceded in 4 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.52 goals per game, away teams 1.20.
Recent league form (newest first): Manchester United FC LLDDD, Aston Villa FC DWWDW (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.

Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
